clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Renferrel sends you to Hadrec as the Scourge threat grows. After Renferrel and Bethor Iceshard investigate the Scourge presence in Lake Lordamere, High Executor Hadrec directs Silverpine's military preparations against Fenris Isle.

Apothecary Renferrel and Bethor Iceshard have studied the danger posed by the renegade necromancer Thule Ravenclaw. But study alone cannot break the Scourge stronghold rising on Fenris Isle. Ravenclaw is binding the restless dead there, and Renferrel sees that alchemy and magic will not be enough. The Forsaken military must bring its steel and discipline to bear, so Renferrel sends you to the commander.

High Executor Hadrec directs Silverpine Forest's strategic operations for the Dark Lady from the Sepulcher's crypts. Bethor's warnings about Ravenclaw reach him, and Hadrec knows a necromancer entrenched on Lordamere's western shore threatens Undercity's flank. He opens the local garrison's armory to equip the vanguard before sending them against the island fortress.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec. He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If what Bethor says is true then Thule Ravenclaw is a force that must be dealt with, and dealt with soon.
To aid in this task, you may take something from our arsenal here...
